_comment: 🔣️ SSOT taxonomy vocabulary. Ticket 26/08/12/DISSOLVE-KERNELS-AND-MODULES-INTO-EVENT-SOURCED-ARTIFACTS: authored implementation lives at <semantic-collection>/<specific>/<file-kind-emoji>.<registered-extension>; reusable modules require two independent production semantic consumers at their lowest common owner.
_semanticCollectionsComment: 🧩️ semanticCollections is the schema-first collection vocabulary. Every listed root uses semanticManifestFileKindId and semanticExtensionKey; its manifest members are in exact bijection with direct child directories. Collection roots are generated/mechanical assembly only.
_standardsSubsetsComment: Artifacts own standards only. Standards own subsets only. Subsets own schema, IO, and examples — never an engine: an artifact is data plus pure transforms, and behaviour belongs to the app that edits it (26/08/12/ENGINELESS-ARTIFACTS-AND-APP-STATE-MACHINES, #2553). Pure algorithms stay legal one level up, in a module's ⚙️engine — taxonomyLeafParentDirs keeps that word globally valid. Builder, analyzer, and composer remain types generated by derive_artifact_facets! / subset!, never filesystem facets. App examples under 🎛️apps stay app-owned.
_subsetVocabularyComment: 🪆️ subsetDirPrefix/subsetSlugPattern/subsetAnyId/subsetAnyDirName define subset shape; each standard owns its content vocabulary in the canonical subsetsManifestFileKindId leaf.
_engineListComment: Completeness/structural child dirs: artifacts declare standards; standards declare subsets; subsets declare schema+io+examples. Nested schema/io declared via schemaChildDirs, representationDirs, ioSemanticCollectionDirNames, ioDirectionDirs, ioDirectionChildDirs.
_treePurityComment: 🌳️ Files use registered kind-only basenames; semantic concerns live in registered emoji-plus-slug directories. Package roots admit only exact contracts and recursively proven glue roles.
_languageNeutralityComment: 🌐️ Language-neutral assets live at the owner root, never inside a package boundary; schema formats and package entries resolve through file-kind and exact-contract identifiers.
_areaStateComment: 🗺️ Every declared and undeclared non-opaque area is clean-enforced. The actual compose and temp/compose prefixes are represented only by pathExclusions.
_surfaceComment: 👁️✏️ Ticket 26/08/16/ARTIFACT-VIEWERS-AND-EDITORS-PER-SUBSET: a SURFACE is a subset-scoped UI binding with a role — 👁️viewer (read-only) or ✏️editor (mutating). Every OWNED subset carries both, beside 🧬️schema/🚪️io/📚️examples; a plugin may also mirror a FOREIGN subset's path to contribute a surface it does not own (contributedSubsetChildDirs), which requires a declared dependency on the owning plugin. Surfaces keep the mode/window shape 🎛️apps used, so modesDirName/windowsDirName/modeChildDirs/windowChildDirs are unchanged and now serve surfaces instead of apps. Sequencing (APA lesson 26/08/12): the surface* keys land FIRST and the app* keys are deleted only once the last 🎛️apps directory is gone — the Rust taxonomy assert! gate requires every listed facet dir on every plugin, so a flip in the other order panics all 33 plugins.
_cleanMechanismComment: 🧹 Ticket 26/08/17/CLEAN-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-MECHANISM, wave W1 (allow-half only — W6 removes the old shapes). Target tree: artifact -> standard -> subset, each level ONE root 🦀️.rs that #[path]-mounts exactly its own child dirs and exports one declaration function (artifact()/standard()/subset()); a subset never `use`s a sibling subset or another standard. ⚠️ CORRECTED SHAPE (W1-E, forced by the W2-P pilot — supersedes the original import/export mirror this comment used to describe): `import`/`export` express DIRECTION, and direction exists ONLY for FOREIGN dialects, at 🚪️io/{📥️import/🧩️deserializers,📤️export/🧵️serializers}/🗿️artifacts/<kind>/🔖️<std>/✳️<sub>/ — because `ArtifactDsl` (parse+print) and `ArtifactPack` (decode+encode) are single, inherently bidirectional traits and Rust allows exactly one impl of a trait per type, so mirroring the SAME native codec under both import and export would force either duplicated codec logic (two sources of truth, the exact thing this ticket exists to remove) or one side being a hollow re-export. The NATIVE codec (text grammar + pack binary protocol) is therefore one bidirectional thing per facet and sits DIRECTLY under 🚪️io/<facet>/{📝️text,💾️binary}, unsplit, for all four schemaChildDirs members (📸️snapshot,🔺️diff,🧬️mutations,💡️inferences) — reusing schemaChildDirs x representationDirs rather than a new key, and reusing the existing ioSemanticCollectionDirNames + semanticCollections["🚪️io/<facet>"] mechanism 🧬️mutations/💡️inferences already used pre-correction (now joined by 📸️snapshot/🔺️diff, all four direction:"transport" except 💡️inferences which stays "export"-only since inferences are derived, never imported), carrying the SAME spec filenames 🧬️schema/* carries today (📖️.grammar.semio / 📡️.protocol.semio / 🔣️.json). Anyone extending this vocabulary MUST NOT re-derive the rejected import/export mirror for the native codec — see the ⚠️ CORRECTION block in the ticket's 📓️design.md §1 and 📓️w1-e-report.md for the full reasoning. Shared code lives in 🔨️modules at the lowest common owner (standard -> artifact -> plugin -> ✏️s/🔨️modules -> framework), never at subset level. This wave adds 🔨️modules as an OPTIONAL (not required) child of plugin/artifact/standard roots — pluginChildDirs/artifactChildDirs/standardChildDirs grew the entry but pluginRequiredChildDirs/(no artifact- or standard-level required list exists) did NOT, so no completeness gate can fire on a still-missing 🔨️modules dir. The old 🧬️schema/*/{📝️text,💾️binary} entries stay valid meanwhile (both shapes legal during migration; W6 deletes the old one). Module-path slugs (policy policyOwnerMountsChildrenBreaches, script.ts policyModulePathSlug/policyStandardModulePathSlug): strip the emoji prefix, kebab->snake, a leading digit gets an underscore prefix (📄txt->txt, ◻2d->_2d, 🧊️3d->_3d, 🖐️5d->_5d, ✳️i-json->i_json); a standard slug (standardDirPrefix) additionally gets prefixed 'v' when it starts with a digit or 'v_' when it starts with a letter, with '.'/'-' folded to '_' first (🔖️1->v1, 🔖️1.4->v1_4, 🔖️89a->v89a, 🔖️ap214->v_ap214, 🔖️ecma-376->v_ecma_376, 🔖️riff-pcm->v_riff_pcm) — this is a pure algorithm parameterized by the pre-existing standardDirPrefix/subsetDirPrefix keys, so no new taxonomy data key was needed for it.

ticket-report.reason: A 📓️-slugged file under a ticket directory is a narrative record of what was true when it was written, per CLAUDE.md's own ticket protocol (research/summary markdown). Document kind, not the owning ticket's open/closed lifecycle status, is the discriminator: rewriting it would falsify the record it keeps, and blocking on its bare prose would freeze the whole repository on prose in any ticket, open or closed. The whole document is therefore excluded from reference-candidate scanning unconditionally.

ticket-workspace.reason: Any descendant of a ticket root, at any nesting depth, that is not itself a registered fixedFilenameContracts file is ticket workspace — evidence snapshots (e.g. *.pre-patch.rs), scratch scripts, census/log output, working notes (📌️*.md), and their own nested subfolders (e.g. 📥️worker-bootstrap/, 🧪️run-*/) — never a live reference. Depth was never the safety property: it is exempted only when it is not itself a fixedFilenameContracts match AND no ancestor directory up to the ticket root owns a package-root manifest (Cargo.toml/package.json/go.mod/…, any fixedFilenameContracts entry with scope.kind==="package-root"); a ticket-embedded package, and any fixed-filename contract file wherever it sits (e.g. 📜️script.ts, matched by root-script's own **/📜️script.ts pattern regardless of location), keeps its normal live-reference treatment.

cursor-plan-snapshot.reason: Cursor IDE plan snapshots are historical planning narrative authored by a separate tool with no ticket-lifecycle concept; they are never live references and are unconditionally excluded from reference-candidate scanning.

dev-prompt-log.reason: Each file under 💬️prompts/ is one developer's own running prompt-log transcript — narrative of what was asked and done at the time, per the same argument that already exempts 📓️ ticket reports and Cursor plan snapshots: rewriting a transcript falsifies the historical record it keeps, and blocking a rename on a bare path token quoted somewhere in a dev's prompt history would freeze the whole repository on prose nobody intends to keep in sync. Unlike ticket-report this population carries no 📓️ prefix and no ticket-lifecycle concept at all — the directory itself (one markdown file per developer, e.g. 🐙️ueli.md, 🐳️kinan.md, 🦢️niloufar.md) is the whole population, discriminated purely by location. Still subject to both existing negatives: never exempts a fixedFilenameContracts match, and never exempts a path inside a directory (up to 💬️prompts/ itself) that owns a package-root manifest.

- **Workspace root** (`/script.ts`): same `Script` base class with `ScriptRouter` over workspace verbs (see root `script.ts`).

rustEntryPathRules._comment: 🦀️ #[path] resolution is CUMULATIVE: every nested `pub mod X { … }` resolves its own #[path] against its immediately enclosing scope's ALREADY-RESOLVED dir, and `#[path = "."]` means "keep the enclosing base". Under entryLocation="packages" the entry file sits entryDirFromOwner deep, so the owner tree is leafPathPrefix away. TWO conventions are valid and both appear in the repo today (confirmed by real compiles: 🏛️architect/📸️remodel/🖍️draw use leaf-prefixed, 🖨️raster uses once-reset) — a validator must model the base stack, not do a flat join.

_testTaxonomyComment: 🧪️ Tests belong to the nearest language-neutral owner and use file-kind identifiers; no language-neutral test filename is exempt from normalization.
_testContributionComment: 🧩️ Open/closed extension point. An owner that needs a reference implementation, an oracle crate or a format-specific comparison profile declares them in `<owner>/🧪️oracle/🔣️.json`. The framework test domain DISCOVERS those manifests; it never names an owner, a plugin or a format. Adding PDF, PNG or any future artifact therefore requires zero framework edits.
_testMutationVocabularyComment: 🦠️ The directory an implementation puts a mutation vocabulary in. Named here as VOCABULARY so the contract can ask 'is this declared vocabulary claimed by a catalog?' without the framework learning any format, language or plugin. A subset that declares a vocabulary and no catalog is invisible to the completeness gate — that gap let two subsets ship handcrafted mutations with no test at all.
_areaLayerComment: 🏛️ Dependency direction. `repo-wide` code (the root router, root manifests) and `framework` code may be depended UPON by an implementation, never the reverse: deleting an `implementation` area must leave every `repo-wide` and `framework` file correct and up to date. An implementation-specific rule therefore belongs in that implementation's own 📜️script.ts, which the policy plugin already discovers, not in the root router. Enforced by `bun ./📜️script.ts verify layering` against the shrink-only baseline 🔒️layering.json.
_mutationOwnershipComment: 🧬️ Every concrete 🧬️mutations/<emoji><verb>-<noun>/ directory directly owns one 🦀️.rs holding only its payload and dispatch. This is a PLACEMENT rule, not a completeness one: whenever a mutation's own apply/payload-definition, diff, or inverse behavior exists, it lives in its own facet directory — 🦠️mutation, 🔺️diff, ↩️inverse (mutationBehaviorFacetDirs) — and must never be inlined back into the direct leaf; mutationDirectLeafForbiddenRegionMarkers names the exact region marker whose presence in the direct leaf proves an inlining regression for 🔺️diff/↩️inverse. 🧩️plan, 📝️text, 💾️binary and 🧬️schema remain optional organizational facets (mutationOrganizationalFacetDirs), genuinely absent for many mutations and never a completeness requirement. The 🧬️mutations root is transparent assembly only.
_stateLaneComment: 🫧️ Ticket 26/08/13/UNIFIED-STATE-ARCHITECTURE-AND-DEMONSTRATOR-RESTORATION wave A0: exactly four state mechanisms exist, enforced by API and policy — 🗿️artifacts = persisted shared, 🎚️config = persisted local-only, 👥️presence = ephemeral shared, 🫧️transient = ephemeral local-only UI state. Every state-owning scope (app, mode, window) carries the same three non-artifact lanes as sibling facet dirs, each shaped by configChildDirs/presenceChildDirs/transientChildDirs. modeChildDirs did not exist before this wave: modes had no declared children at all, so a mode-scoped config/presence/transient facet had nowhere legal to live. Draftness is a LANE property (which store a record lives in), never a field annotation, so `preview` folded into the artifact lane; `effect` was deleted (effects are Emit.effects, not state); and `inferred` left the state axis entirely for the orthogonal `#[derived]` / `x-semio-derived` marker.
_testComparisonProfilesComment: ⚖️ The DOMAIN-NEUTRAL profiles the framework itself owns. A profile that knows a file format (semantic-pdf-v1, semantic-raster-v1, …) belongs to the owner of that format and is contributed through its `testContributionDirName` manifest — the framework supplies the comparison MECHANISM, never the per-format policy.
_layeringGeneratedContractsComment: 🏛️ Generated layering inputs may use only exact contract IDs; generated banners remain content evidence.
